global_source_metadata: source-manifest.json applies to every title and section record.

selected-sections.jsonl.record_unit: One source heading and all bytes up to the next identified heading or selected-title boundary. Do not call these independently validated operative statutes.
selected-sections.jsonl.id: Stable within this pinned original: nj-{title}-{original TXT byte start}; use together with source SHA256 across versions.
selected-sections.jsonl.citation: Source heading citation with only its terminal heading punctuation period removed.
selected-sections.jsonl.heading: Source heading text; RTF transport line wrapping removed; meaningful text preserved.
selected-sections.jsonl.headnote: Source heading after the citation; not an AI summary.
selected-sections.jsonl.source_byte_start: Inclusive zero-based byte offset in original STATUTES.TXT.
selected-sections.jsonl.source_byte_end_exclusive: Exclusive zero-based byte offset in original STATUTES.TXT.
selected-sections.jsonl.source_line_end_1based: Last included source TXT line; one-based inclusive.
selected-sections.jsonl.rtf_heading_byte_start: Zero-based RTF anchor. Normal entries point to the s3 paragraph start; two documented exceptions point to the heading text start. Use boundary_method to distinguish.
selected-sections.jsonl.boundary_method: Evidence used to establish the section boundary; includes reviewed nonstandard-style exceptions.
selected-sections.jsonl.source_slice_sha256: SHA256 of original TXT byte slice, before any Unicode serialization.
selected-sections.jsonl.text: Exact byte slice decoded as Windows-1252; retains CRLF, heading, body and history. Encode Windows-1252 to verify hash.
selected-sections.jsonl.citation_occurrence: One-based occurrence of this citation in selected source order.
selected-sections.jsonl.citation_occurrences_in_selection: How many source records carry the citation; >1 requires version/citation review.
selected-sections.jsonl.source_cues: Literal headnote word cues or duplicate-citation notices, not legal-status conclusions.

title-index.json.record_unit: One of 69 title spans or Appendix A in the original corpus.
title-index.json.selected: True only for the seven exported complete-title extracts.
title-index.json.source_heading: Exact source title heading text as matched across RTF and TXT.
title-index.json.title: Readable display title; official title wording retained.
title-index.json.scope: Editorial scope note, separate from statutory text.
title-index.json.source_byte_start/source_byte_end_exclus: Same half-open original TXT byte convention as sections.
title-index.json.sha256: Hash of complete original title span, including heading and whitespace.
title-index.json.title_prefix_text: All title bytes before the first indexed record, decoded as Windows-1252.
title-index.json.derived_text_path: Bundle-relative exact-title TXT path; present only for selected titles.
title-index.json.complete_source_span_reconstructed: True only when prefix plus indexed records exactly reproduce selected title bytes.

presentation_rules: Show publisher cutoff and retrieval date separately; show unresolved cutoff discrepancy prominently.
Use snapshot/reference labels; do not label law current, validated effective, court form, or Word template.
Show both occurrences of duplicated citations, with headnotes and review flag.
Do not infer subsection/paragraph pinpoints from this headnote index.
Treat TXT title files as Windows-1252 when reading; JSON and Markdown metadata are UTF-8.
Escape source text in web interfaces and do not treat source text as instructions.
